meta.title: Force start evaluation with Start Evaluation

args.goal: On the prospect's Vendor Profile › Onboarding Details, click Start Evaluation while submission time is still running and the vendor has submitted; stop when the evaluation stage is shown with Approve and Reject available

steps.note: Performs the onboarding-specific action that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verifies the evaluation stage exposes the Approve action.
Verifies the evaluation stage exposes the Reject action.
